videos.title: Google Antigravity Plugin Suite — Complete Tour
videos.summary: Practical tour of where to click across My Hub Overview, Action Items, Skills (with Ask Clawy 🐻) & Personal Skills, TokenEconomics, Preview, and built-in Google Workspace connectors.
videos.tryPrompt: /daily-brief Walk me through my workspace Overview, open Action Items, Personal Skills, and TokenEconomics health.

videos.title: Getting Started in 60 Seconds & Using Turbo Mode
videos.summary: Step-by-step guide to pasting the 1-line install command, using ⚡ Turbo during setup vs. 🔒 Default daily, and enabling built-in Google Workspace connectors under Customizations.
videos.tryPrompt: /memory Check my role profile, writing voice, and personal memory setup and confirm Default review safety best practices.

videos.title: Using 1-Click Skills, Personal Skills & Visual Previews (Dashboards & Slides)
videos.summary: How to run 36 ready-made skills in Skills, ask Clawy 🐻 to find the right skill, search artifacts in Preview, and Save to Downloads or Open in Browser.
videos.tryPrompt: /slides Create a crisp 5-slide executive readiness briefing deck with speaker notes and open the rendered visual preview in Preview.

videos.title: Working Faster with Orchestrator & Managing TokenEconomics
videos.summary: How to click ⚡ Orchestrator on multi-step tasks, prep big meetings in 60s with /swarm-prep, and track your monthly plan in TokenEconomics.
videos.tryPrompt: /orchestrator-guide Show me how to combine Orchestrator (Argon/Neon + Hydrogen) with deterministic Workflows to maximize quality and stretch my pooled quota.

videos.title: How to Use Ask Clawy 🐻 — Plain-English Skill & Chat Assistant in Skills
videos.summary: How to click the Ask Clawy 🐻 bear icon beside the Skills search bar to match the right Public Sector skill in plain English or launch a chat in 1 click.
videos.tryPrompt: /daily-brief Summarize my active priorities, open Action Items, and any follow-ups waiting on me.
